task: Multi-Object Tracking with Pseudo-Depth Hierarchical Association
scientific_target: Handle occlusions and improve MOT performance in crowded scenes by decomposing dense target sets into sparse subsets via pseudo-depth estimation and hierarchical association

methods.name: ByteTrack
methods.description: Baseline tracker using two-stage association: high-score detections first, then low-score detections

methods.name: SparseTrack
methods.description: Proposed method using pseudo-depth estimation to decompose dense scenes into sparse subsets for hierarchical association
